title: Senior Magento Developer
description:
Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

New roles for Senior Magento Engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now.

Two ways to work with clients

  • Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it.
  • Direct hire: some clients hire engineers full-time, and we support you through the process.

Because companies trust our vetting, applying through Lemon.io is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own.

What you get

  • Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills
  • We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.
  • Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours.
location: Europe, LATAM, APAC, the U.S., Canada

description:

Who they’re looking for: Site Reliability Engineer, Senior Back-end Developer with Golang, Senior Back-end Developer with Python, AI Infrastructure Engineer, Distributed Storage Engineer, DevOps.

Requirements for Senior Back-end Developers with Golang

  • 5+ years of commercial experience with Golang
  • 2+ years of commercial experience with Kubernetes
  • 1+ year of experience in AI-assisted coding
  • Experience with distributed systems

Requirements for Senior Back-end Developers with Python

  • 5+ years of commercial experience with Python

  • 2+ years of commercial experience with Kubernetes
  • 1+ year

title: Looking For Online ESL Teachers - Remote- Joining Rewards of up to USD $100
description:
Polly English is an online English teaching company based in Singapore. We specialize in teaching English to students aged 3 to 18 across Asia, using interactive courseware inspired by Oxford Thinkers and delivered through our self-developed online classrooms. Our unique approach ensures high-interaction, high-quality classes designed to enhance students' English proficiency.

Why Join Polly English?

Our flagship offering is one-on-one online teaching, enabling us to provide customized courses tailored to each student's needs.

  • Compensation: $16–$24 per hour.

Application Process

To apply, simply follow this link: https://teach.pollyenglish.cn/website?ch_i=94f0a475a30e4c6e8d667e5793e09991

Once submitted, kindly notify us so we can expedite your application, considering your valuable teaching experience.

To welcome our new North American teachers, we're excited to offer exclusive New Teacher Rewards of up to USD $100 for teachers who join us and start teaching between August 14 and September 30.

🌟 Core Reward Rules

All rewards are subject to the following conditions:

  • Your first class must be completed by September 30.
